author: Max Stoddard
description: Structured dashboard-facing history for input-data versions, calibration provenance, and legacy WAS validation diffs.

fields.version_id: Display version id in notes (for example v0a, v2.1, v4.0).
fields.snapshot_folder: Snapshot folder under input-data-versions/ used by switch-input-data.sh.
fields.validation_dataset: WAS dataset key used for validation (w3 or r8).
fields.description: Human description of what changed for this version.
fields.updated_data_sources: Short source tags previously shown in brackets.
fields.calibration_files: Calibration or update script path(s) for this version.
fields.config_parameters: Config keys changed at this version milestone.
fields.parameter_changes: Per-parameter change list with config key and resolved dataset source (or null for scalar-only changes).
fields.dataset_source: Resolved config value for file-backed parameters (for example src/main/resources/*.csv); null when not file-backed.

validation.status: Validation status recorded for the snapshot entry: complete | in_progress.
validation.income_diff_pct: Legacy WAS validation income total diff percentage; nullable when the tracked validation summary no longer emits this field.
validation.housing_wealth_diff_pct: Legacy WAS validation housing wealth total diff percentage; nullable when the tracked validation summary no longer emits this field.
validation.financial_wealth_diff_pct: Legacy WAS validation financial wealth total diff percentage; nullable when the tracked validation summary no longer emits this field.
validation.note: Optional release-note or tracked-validation summary text, especially for modern summaries that do not use the legacy diff fields.

entries.description: Original model + Wave 3 val
Original model + Round 8 val
Replaced DATA_INCOME_GIVEN_AGE with the R8 weighted age-income joint distribution using positive-and-trimmed non-rent income filtering.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Switched to filtered and trimmed weighted age-income joint estimation to reduce unstable tail-driven bins.
method_variations.why_changed: To improve robustness of empirical density estimates while preserving the central income-age structure used by the model.
method_variations.method_chosen: weighted log-income by age joint distribution with positive-and-trimmed income filtering
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=positive filtering and tail trimming stabilize bin estimates; Tradeoff=extreme tails are removed from calibration support.

entries.description: Replaced DATA_WEALTH_GIVEN_INCOME with the R8 weighted gross-income/net-wealth joint distribution in log space.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Moved to log-space weighted gross-income/net-wealth joint estimation with positive-wealth and filtered-income constraints.
method_variations.why_changed: To produce cleaner and more stable wealth-income joint densities and avoid distortions from invalid wealth support.
method_variations.method_chosen: weighted joint distribution for gross income vs net wealth in log space
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=positive wealth constraints and filtered income support stable log-space joint densities; Tradeoff=non-positive wealth rows are excluded.

entries.description: Switched DATA_BTL_PROBABILITY to the R8 buy-to-let probability table built from non-rent income percentile bins.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Standardized to direct percentile-bin estimation of BTL probability using non-rent income ranking and rental-income positivity marker.
method_variations.why_changed: To align empirical calibration output to the required model table shape with transparent, reproducible semantics.
method_variations.method_chosen: percentile binning over gross non-rent income and rental-income positivity as BTL marker
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=target reproduction; Why=direct percentile-bin estimator aligns with required output table shape; Tradeoff=keeps a simple semantic indicator instead of model-heavy inference.

entries.description: Replaced DATA_AGE_DISTRIBUTION with the R8 weighted 8-band age distribution using the 75-95 compatibility tail bin.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Recomputed weighted age histogram under R8 while retaining compatibility banding convention.
method_variations.why_changed: To update empirical age structure with newer data without breaking downstream assumptions tied to legacy age-band shape.
method_variations.method_chosen: weighted age histogram by WAS age bands
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=backward compatibility; Why=R8 75-95 convention preserves downstream compatibility while updating dataset coverage; Tradeoff=retains legacy-style age-band structure.

entries.description: Updated DATA_NATIONAL_INSURANCE_RATES to the 2025-2026 Class 1 employee contribution table.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Replaced NI thresholds/rates with direct source-of-truth policy values for the target tax regime.
method_variations.why_changed: To keep model deductions empirically aligned with official policy tables instead of stale historical bands.
method_variations.method_chosen: direct table update from source data
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=target reproduction; Why=policy-table parameters are direct-source values rather than inferred estimates; Tradeoff=depends on source table update cadence.

entries.description: Updated DATA_TAX_RATES to the 2025-2026 UK income tax band table.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Updated income-tax thresholds and rates directly from official tables.
method_variations.why_changed: To maintain empirical realism in post-tax income calculations and affordability behavior under current policy values.
method_variations.method_chosen: direct table update from source data
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=target reproduction; Why=tax bands/rates are direct-source values and should not be statistically fitted; Tradeoff=depends on source table update cadence.

entries.description: Updated GOVERNMENT_GENERAL_PERSONAL_ALLOWANCE and GOVERNMENT_MONTHLY_INCOME_SUPPORT to the modern policy baseline used by the R8 calibration branch.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Introduced allowance-policy selection using empirical fit comparison against observed net incomes.
method_variations.why_changed: To choose policy settings with better measured agreement to validation targets rather than preserving legacy assumptions.
method_variations.method_chosen: compare log-squared fit to observed net incomes under two allowance assumptions
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=single allowance minimizes fit error vs observed net incomes under current pipeline; Tradeoff=diagnostic comparison, not a full fiscal-policy model.

entries.description: Recalibrated HOUSE_PRICES_SCALE and HOUSE_PRICES_SHAPE from 2025 Land Registry Price Paid Data using the focused status-A lognormal fit.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Adopted focused status-A lognormal fitting with population moments for house prices.
method_variations.why_changed: To reduce noise sensitivity and improve parameter stability under current transaction-data quality.
method_variations.method_chosen: focused status-A method with population standard deviation
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=status-A filtering and population moments provide cleaner, stable estimates under current data assumptions; Tradeoff=small residual mismatch vs legacy targets may persist from data drift.

entries.description: Recalibrated RENTAL_PRICES_SCALE and RENTAL_PRICES_SHAPE from the 2024 NMG renter sample using the qhousing {3,4} weighted lognormal fit.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Selected weighted private-renter subset fitting for rental lognormal parameters.
method_variations.why_changed: To better reproduce calibration targets with method choices shown empirically strongest in search.
method_variations.method_chosen: weighted lognormal fit over private renter qhousing values
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=target reproduction; Why=weighted qhousing {3,4} variant is closest/exact at displayed precision in search results; Tradeoff=ties method to private-renter subset definition.

entries.description: Recalibrated DESIRED_RENT_SCALE and DESIRED_RENT_EXPONENT from 2024 NMG midpoint income/rent data using the weighted log-space fit.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Switched to midpoint mapping plus weighted log-space regression for desired-rent power fit.
method_variations.why_changed: To reduce high-rent and upper-bound bias while retaining strong reproduction of target coefficients.
method_variations.method_chosen: midpoint mappings with weighted log-space regression
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=target reproduction; Why=midpoint mappings with log-weighted fitting reproduce targets while reducing upper-bound and high-rent bias; Tradeoff=not optimized for level-space SSE.

entries.description: Updated BTL_P_INCOME_DRIVEN and BTL_P_CAPITAL_DRIVEN from the 2024 NMG legacy-weighted BTL strategy aggregation.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Used legacy-weighted strategy aggregation with schema fallback for BTL split estimation.
method_variations.why_changed: To preserve behavioral continuity while supporting newer input schema variants.
method_variations.method_chosen: legacy-weighted strategy aggregation with schema auto-detection
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=backward compatibility; Why=legacy_weighted preserves historical strategy semantics while supporting 2024 schema fallback; Tradeoff=keeps legacy classification structure.

entries.description: Updated MORTGAGE_DURATION_YEARS using the PSD 2024 modal-midpoint term method selected for stability.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Adopted modal-midpoint term calibration selected for quarter-to-quarter stability.
method_variations.why_changed: To prioritize robust reproduction under repeated calibrations instead of minimum single-run distance.
method_variations.method_chosen: modal_midpoint_round with open-top year assumption 45
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=modal midpoint was top-ranked for rounded quarter-to-quarter stability; Tradeoff=not always minimum raw-distance estimator.

entries.description: Updated DOWNPAYMENT_FTB_SCALE and DOWNPAYMENT_FTB_SHAPE using the PSD 2024 median-anchored non-FTB proxy downpayment fit.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Used median-anchored downpayment fitting with within-bin integration for FTB parameters.
method_variations.why_changed: To improve robustness of estimated distribution shape across plausible tail assumptions.
method_variations.method_chosen: median_anchored_nonftb_independent with within-bin integration points 11
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=median anchoring and within-bin integration improved robust reproducibility across candidate tails; Tradeoff=not always the closest method by raw error in expanded grids.

entries.description: Updated DOWNPAYMENT_OO_SCALE and DOWNPAYMENT_OO_SHAPE using the PSD 2024 constrained non-FTB proxy owner-occupier fit.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Applied constrained non-FTB proxy downpayment fitting for owner-occupier parameter stability.
method_variations.why_changed: To derive robust OO downpayment estimates despite limited direct observability of true OO-only bins.
method_variations.method_chosen: median_anchored_nonftb_independent with non-FTB proxy from all-minus-FTB bins
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=stability/robustness; Why=non-FTB proxy with constrained physical tail assumptions gave robust production estimates; Tradeoff=accepts proxy contamination risk vs unavailable direct OO observables.

entries.description: Promoted BUY_SCALE, BUY_EXPONENT, BUY_MU, and BUY_SIGMA to the constrained-quantile BUY v2 production calibration.

validation.note: Stable v4.0 release from modern realism-constrained BUY* calibration with completed R8 validation.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Promoted BUY* to a modern realism-constrained quantile method with explicit hard gates and completed validation.
method_variations.why_changed: To prevent implausible desired-purchase behavior while keeping calibration anchored to PSD 2024 and PPD 2024/2025 evidence.
method_variations.method_chosen: constrained quantile fit with Pareto top-bin modeling and objective penalties (anchor+p95+sigma+curve), selecting BUY_SCALE=7.6238412132, BUY_EXPONENT=1.0028939531, BUY_MU=0, BUY_SIGMA=0.4326188972
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=realism-first constrained optimization with explicit guardrails and diagnostics blocks invalid promotions while remaining data-anchored; Tradeoff=legacy 2011 target closeness is comparison-only.

entries.description: Promoted HPA_EXPECTATION_FACTOR and HPA_EXPECTATION_CONST to the preferred 2024 national midpoint_exact Category-A Huber expectation fit and republished validation.

validation.note: Tracked 2024 validation summary regenerated on 2026-04-15T10:26:37Z after promoting the Huber HPA expectation default. overallCompositeLoss=0.655058. Required metrics passing: Housing Transactions, Advances to FTB, Household Debt to Income, House Price to Household Disposable Income, House Price Growth, Income Distribution Realism, Housing Wealth Distribution Realism, and Financial Wealth Distribution Realism. Required metrics failing: Mortgage Approvals, Advances to Home Movers, Advances to BTL, HPI Mean, HPI Std, HPI Cycle Period, Owner-Occupier Debt to Income, Rental Yield, and Interest Rate Spread. The tracked validation summary no longer emits the legacy total-diff percentage fields.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Replaced the rejected all-transactions expectation proxy with the revised Category A-only annualised PPD signal and promoted the admissible midpoint_exact fit into the v4.2 snapshot.
method_variations.why_changed: To avoid shipping the negative-factor all-transactions fit while keeping the production expectation rule simple, reproducible, and aligned with the approved v4.2 design.
method_variations.method_chosen: Category A only + annual_mean_annualised + midpoint_exact over the 2018-2024 NMG window, yielding HPA_EXPECTATION_FACTOR=0.1150752545 and HPA_EXPECTATION_CONST=0.0034084162; the all-transactions comparison was rejected at factor=-0.0919792144 and const=0.0104582814; strict 2020-2024 sensitivity remained admissible at factor=0.0535966141 and const=0.0092043687.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=rank admissible before inadmissible, then preferred-band status, in-window RMSE, and simplicity under the fixed Category A annual_mean_annualised production surface; Tradeoff=the winning fit is admissible but outside the preferred factor band, early anchors still rely on fallback bases (2018->2012, 2019->2018), and 2025 PPD remains excluded to avoid future leakage.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Promoted the preferred-band Huber default and replaced the earlier v4.2 Category-A OLS pair with the stronger national midpoint_exact fit.
method_variations.why_changed: To make the defended 2024 recalibration method the repo default rather than keeping the earlier simpler OLS fallback, while preserving a transparent history of the superseded v4.2 values.
method_variations.method_chosen: BoE NMG Survey waves 2018-2024, diagnostic NMG waves 2015-2017 and 2025-pt1/2025-pt2, and Land Registry Price Paid Data 2011, 2012, and 2018-2025; national_cross_section + midpoint_exact + annual_mean_annualised + Category A + Huber, yielding HPA_EXPECTATION_FACTOR=0.2887897073 and HPA_EXPECTATION_CONST=-0.0059593352. This replaced the earlier v4.2 OLS values HPA_EXPECTATION_FACTOR=0.1150752545 and HPA_EXPECTATION_CONST=0.0034084162.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=defensible 2024 recalibration; Why=the narrowed production search now defaults to the national midpoint_exact Category-A annualised Huber fit because it lands in the preferred plausibility band and is more robust to unstable survey years than the earlier OLS default; Tradeoff=the live v4.2 coefficients move materially away from the superseded simpler OLS pair and the current linkage workbook still does not support matched-panel production fits across 2018-2024.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Promoted the bank credit-response coefficient to the positive full-overlap spread-delta versus credit-delta fit.
method_variations.why_changed: To calibrate the demand-response term directly against the model’s own monthly update equation while rejecting the negative 2024-only fit.
method_variations.method_chosen: Through-origin fit on Delta spread_fraction = beta * Delta credit_per_household over the full 1995-2024 overlap, yielding BANK_D_INTEREST_D_DEMAND=5.471987263431394e-07; rejected 2024-only fit = -5.91912917550825e-06.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the longer pre-2025 overlap yields a positive coefficient under the model-consistent delta equation while the 2024-only fit is negative and therefore not defensible as the live default; Tradeoff=the promoted coefficient is materially smaller than the legacy value and this intermediate version worsens several macro credit and affordability metrics versus v4.4.

entries.description: Rebased UK_HOUSEHOLDS and UK_DWELLINGS to the retained official 2024 ONS and country dwelling-stock artifacts using source-native downloadable values.

validation.note: Tracked 2024 validation summary regenerated on 2026-04-15T17:34:28Z after promoting the official 2024 UK household and dwelling stock totals. overallCompositeLoss=0.474122 versus v4.6=0.355437 (delta +0.118685). Required metrics passing: Advances to FTB, Advances to Home Movers, House Price Growth, Interest Rate Spread, Income Distribution Realism, and Financial Wealth Distribution Realism. Required metrics warning: HPI Mean and HPI Cycle Period. Required metrics failing: Mortgage Approvals, Housing Transactions, Advances to BTL, Household Debt to Income, House Price to Household Disposable Income, HPI Std, Owner-Occupier Debt to Income, Rental Yield, and Housing Wealth Distribution Realism. Status changes versus v4.6: Housing Transactions pass->fail, Advances to Home Movers fail->pass, Household Debt to Income pass->fail, House Price to Household Disposable Income pass->fail, HPI Mean fail->warn, HPI Cycle Period fail->warn, and Housing Wealth Distribution Realism pass->fail. The corrected stock totals materially increase the implied houses-per-household target from 0.855681 to 1.072284, so this release should be treated as an official-source stock correction with a validation regression rather than a fit improvement. The prior v4.6 BoE per-household denominator remains intentionally unchanged in this version.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Rebased the UK household and dwelling stock anchors to the retained 2024 official artifacts using source-native downloadable values instead of rounded public headline comparators.
method_variations.why_changed: To make the stock anchors directly reproducible from the official source files and to avoid mixing rounded England and Scotland headline figures with more granular downloadable tables.
method_variations.method_chosen: UK_HOUSEHOLDS from the ONS workbook sheet 5 'All households' 2024 Estimate = 28,609 thousand => 28,609,000; UK_DWELLINGS = England 25,617,413 + Wales 1,482,600 + Scotland 2,740,973 + Northern Ireland 835,988 = 30,676,974; rejected rounded comparators: 28,600,000 households and 30,679,588 dwellings.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the downloadable official artifacts provide the most auditable published 2024 totals and avoid mixed-precision headline drift; Tradeoff=the corrected stock totals materially worsen v4.7 validation versus v4.6 and the prior BoE per-household denominator remains intentionally unresolved in this release.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Replaced the unresolved legacy BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN = 1.2 note with a retained public-lender proxy floor of 1.25 from Paragon's 2024 criteria.
method_variations.why_changed: To move BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN onto a defensible 2024 lender-side source without pretending that the available public evidence is a weighted market-wide estimate, while keeping the effective live floor at max(1.25, 1.2) = 1.25 because CENTRAL_BANK_ICR_HARD_MIN remains unchanged.
method_variations.method_chosen: literal_standard_floor_125 = minimum retained Paragon 2024 decision threshold across 1.25, 1.25, 1.30, 1.30, 1.40, 1.40, 1.45, 1.45; rejected alternatives: stress_mapped_floor = 1.22 and cross_segment_mean = 1.35; UK Finance Q1-Q4 2024 ICRs = 1.91, 1.96, 1.95, 2.01 retained as context only.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=the literal 125% lender floor is the least assumption-heavy semantic match to the model's hard BTL underwriting rule once the mismatched CHL/CMI file is excluded and UK Finance outcomes are treated as context only; Tradeoff=the promoted value is a public proxy rather than a weighted market-wide threshold, and the stressed-rate versus live-rate mismatch remains a documented model limitation.

method_variations.improvement_summary: Rebased the model HRP age-density file to FRS 2023-24 household data with a 15-bin variable-width output.
method_variations.why_changed: To use a newer household survey window than WAS Round 8 for the demographic age structure while preserving the model's age-density file contract.
method_variations.method_chosen: Weighted FRS hhageGR4 histogram using gross4, with hhagegrp rejected because it is anonymized as A in househol.csv and the hhageGR4 75+ tail split uniformly into 75-80, 80-85, and 85-95.
method_variations.decision_logic: Objective=direct method justification; Why=hhageGR4 is the only populated granular HRP age field in the supplied FRS household file and gross4 is the household grossing weight; Tradeoff=the last three output bins are an explicit uniform tail split from 75+ rather than directly observed 75-79, 80-84, and 85+ bins.
